author: draganrakita
content:
* GAS opcode not being monotonic. It is a valid concern. But imo this is not property we want to preserve. Gas observability is kinda broken with gas changes that we did. GAS usage should only be part of calculating what % you want to send to subcall.
* On original raised issue. I do agree it is more correct to do parent refill after subcall returns. But I would move this to hegota, it is small change but i dont want to think about edge cases (on subcall or tx return) this late in process. Current logic still works and is fine.

author: spencer_tb
content:
Now that the keep everything as-is train is starting, I will hop on it! +1 to potentially deferring to Hegota 🚆 

On GAS, the only way we I can see us keeping monotonicity is by moving all state refunds to the end of the tx, I don't see that ever happening, there was strong consensus not to do this in Svalbard. I do think its something to be aware about with 8037 and should be added to the EIP text more clearly!

author: misilva73
content: We replayed historical transactions with 8037 and found some transactions breaking for 4337 bundlers. We contacted key dev teams (e.g., zerodev) and they are looking into it. I believe it is not too breaking and they are working on fixes. [Here is the dashboard with the analysis](https://ethereum.github.io/repricing-impact/)

author: misilva73
content: At the time, we decided to not change the concept of GAS - the idea would be to know when your contract is almost out of gas. regular_gas+state_gas would not give the correct view since you cannot use state_gas for everything. So people bight thing they would not OOG, but still go OOG

author: misilva73
content:
For context, <@316280621783580673> :
- [PR 12256](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12256) is just an edit on the EIP (no spec chnage). This is the easiest and I can merge it today.
- [PR 12249](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12249) is asking to goback on our decision to not give an state gas refill when a contract is created and selfdestructed in the same transaction. There were no string feeling about doing this in ACDT and this would definitely be a bigger and complex change than PR 12265
- [PR 12265](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12265) is trying to solve a bug in design for when we have state gas splits that need to be used across different frames. This still requires a spec change, but it is smaller and more contained than PR 12249

The question before us know is whether we want to do 12265. Also, I think it would be great if we could derisk this change going in devnet-8. Can anyone from the client teams create a prototype for Pari so we can try it?
